PIFDataModel

Overview

The PIFDataModel R package is part of the PIF Database Project, which aims to facilitate the sharing and usage of the structured data and JSON schemas associated with the Pathogens in Foods (PIF) Database. This package serves as a repository for database structures, schemas, and related resources to support researchers, food safety professionals, and decision-makers in analyzing data related to pathogens in food.

Features

  • Access to PIF database structures.
  • Tools to validate and manipulate PIF database schemas (under development).

Installation

To install the development version of PIFDataModel, use the following commands in R:

# Install the remotes package if you don't have it
install.packages("remotes")

# Install the PIFDataModel package
remotes::install_github("fsqanalytics/PIFDataModel")

Acknowledgments

The PIF Database and this package are developed as part of a research project funded by the European Food Safety Authority (EFSA). Special thanks to all contributors and collaborators who support this initiative.

Visit the PIF Database Website for more information on the broader project.
